name: Wyatt Au — Intelligence Dashboard
description: Personal intelligence dashboard and portfolio site for Wyatt Au: real-time market data (crypto, macro, equities), earthquake and space-weather OSINT feeds, 16 Rust/WASM interactive quantitative widgets, and an upcoming-launch tracker. All computation is client-side WebAssembly; public data APIs are keyless and edge-cached.

skills.name: Live crypto prices
skills.description: 24-hour Binance USDT mini-ticker snapshot for major pairs (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, ADA) with open/high/low and percent change. GET /api/crypto-ticker

skills.name: Macro rates and risk assets
skills.description: VIX, DXY, 10Y yield, gold, silver, copper, oil spreads and Fear & Greed index from Yahoo Finance and alternative.me. GET /api/stock-quote, /api/fear-greed

skills.name: Earthquake feed
skills.description: USGS all-day earthquake feed as GeoJSON with magnitude, location, and depth. GET /api/earthquakes

skills.name: Space weather and launches
skills.description: NOAA planetary K-index, solar-wind telemetry context, and upcoming orbital launches from Launch Library 2 with provider, rocket, pad, and T-minus. GET /api/kp-index, /api/space-launches

skills.name: Interactive WASM quant widgets
skills.description: 16 client-side Rust/WASM demonstrations: Monte Carlo simulation, SVI vol surface, walk-forward backtesting, Fourier analysis, cellular automata, physics sandbox, and more. Interactive in any browser.

skills.name: Guestbook
skills.description: Public visitor messages persisted in Cloudflare KV. Read-only for agents; writes are interactive-only, rate-limited.

securityRequirements: none — all agent-facing endpoints are public read-only; see /auth.md
